public_funds_boundary.question: Whether third-party units, rooms, jobs, assets or rights were improperly, misleadingly or over-broadly included in eligibility, valuation, financing, tax-incentive, subsidy or public-funding calculations.
public_funds_boundary.limit: No autonomous finding of subsidy fraud or harm to EU financial interests is made unless the grant, beneficiary, declaration, eligibility criteria, award, amount, funding source, eligible expenditure and causation are evidenced.

capacity_and_crossborder.capacity: directly interested / allegedly injured economic party

capacity_and_crossborder.limit: Protection under Spanish Law 2/2023 and EU law depends on statutory personal/material scope and conditions; the label alone does not confer protected status.

capacity_and_crossborder.capacity: Aweswell Limited — UK foreign investor in Spain
capacity_and_crossborder.limit: Relevant to investment, alleged harm and access-to-justice context; it does not by itself create a special jurisdiction, treaty claim or arbitration right.
Any German whistleblower-law or other German-law relevance requires the necessary German factual, professional, reporting or transaction nexus.
UK citizenship or investment ownership alone does not establish statutory whistleblower protection; the relevant legal relationship and disclosure conditions must be shown.

continuity_rule: Corrections supersede rather than erase. Every actor, entity, proceeding, public-funds question and evidence object must retain dated capacity, source, status, limitation, reverse links and a route back to the Puzzle.
